name: The Ritz-Carlton, Aruba
insider_take: This isn't just another Caribbean resort – it's Aruba's first and only Ritz-Carlton, perched on the pristine Palm Beach where trade winds keep temperatures perfect year-round.
whats_special: The resort sits on one of Aruba's most coveted stretches of white sand, where the calm, crystal-clear waters are ideal for swimming. As part of the exclusive STARS program, guests enjoy enhanced amenities like complimentary breakfast, room upgrades, and late checkout. The property features Aruba's only beachfront spa pavilions and offers direct access to some of the island's best snorkeling right off the beach.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the beachfront spa pavilions during sunset hours – the combination of ocean breezes and golden hour lighting creates an unforgettable wellness experience you can't get anywhere else on the island.
dont_miss: The weekly sea turtle nesting tours (seasonal), where guests can witness these ancient mariners laying eggs on the very beach where you're staying. Also explore the nearby Butterfly Farm and Ostrich Farm, both within a 10-minute drive, for unique Aruban wildlife encounters you won't find on other Caribbean islands.
pros: Pristine Palm Beach location with white sand beaches
Signature Ritz-Carlton luxury service and amenities
Multiple dining venues with international cuisine
cons: Popular location can be busy during peak season
